sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

Although the manufacturer recommends that nursing mothers pump and discard breast milk for 5 hours after a dose, anesthesia guidelines recommend that breastfeeding can resume as soon as the mother has recovered sufficiently from general anesthesia to nurse. This strategy was employed at one center with no infant sedation or adverse effects. When a combination of anesthetic agents is used for a procedure, follow the recommendations for the most problematic medication used during the procedure.
